top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is the strongest and most explainable achievement on the slate: one quantitative principle, induced proximity via a ternary complex, turns occupancy-driven pharmacology into catalytic removal of a protein, independently confirmed for two decades. Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated it, and Ciulli supplied the rational, structure-based chemistry (VHL ligands, fully small-molecule degraders, ternary-complex cooperativity) that explains why it works, so P001 gives the most precise and defensible citation. P002 follows because swapping in Handa covers the cereblon/glue arm but gives less explanatory chemistry; P003 and P004 pair degradation or base editing with unrelated parts, diluting citation scope; no award is last because every proposal rewards work of real maturity.
